name: codebase-intelligence
description: Standalone PRP workflow (prp-plan / prp-implement / prp-loop) with Serena LSP structural codebase search, cross-session task memory keyed by Jira ticket + branch, live Jira ticket context injection, a personal KB (local FTS5 vault index), prp-loop (a bounded closed-loop runner with contract-mandated stop rules and an independent verifier), and prp-orchestrate: a mediator-judged parallel agent-team layer (7 generic role specialists in isolated git worktrees, per-round .claude/-rules verdicts, serial merge gate), and pre-pr-gate: a mandatory mechanical + bot-parity gate on the integrated branch before any PR opens (CI-parity typecheck/build/test, dangling+unused-import sweep, applyTo-scoped replay of the repo's own .github rulebook citing its real rule IDs). Self-contained — no prp-core required.
